description.value: D-Plus Pizza is a locally owned Lower Mainland chain blending classic pizza with Indian-inspired dishes — butter chicken, fish pakora, paneer pizza, and donairs all share the menu. The business grew from a single Fraser Valley shop called D Hut Pizza into five locations across Surrey and Delta, and is known for generous portion deals. A passing cyclist would find quick, filling, affordable food available for pickup.

address.value: 10207 King George Blvd, Surrey, BC V3T 2W6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms D-Plus Pizza is a real, active business with 5 locations, all in Surrey and Delta — none in North Vancouver. The OSM phone (+1 604 588 4545) matches exactly the D-Plus Pizza Central location at 10207 King George Blvd, Surrey on the website's /locations/ page, anchoring this record to that address. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website; takeout/pickup is confirmed by the online ordering flow.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website lists only Surrey and Delta locations; OSM coordinates (49.1880, -122.8465) fall in Surrey, not North Vancouver — likely a community-tagging error in OSM.
